latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Digital Drawing Studio, a comprehensive digital art learning companion.

- Guides users from initial sketch to finished digital illustration.
- Covers fundamental drawing techniques, digital tools, and creative exercises for all skill levels.
- Includes structured daily practice routines and specialized subject tracks (characters, environments, creatures, objects, abstract).
- Offers tailored feedback, mini-projects, and step-by-step project workflows.
- Promotes safe and healthy digital art habits.
